items.title: D’Angelo Russell cut was a given. Carson Cooper will be in that spot by Monday. The primary remaining question is whether the Grizzlies roster Richie Saunders for camp or hold off on that (since he can’t play yet). If they wait, Hawkins and Peavy might both be in camp.
items.author: Chris Herrington
items.body_excerpt: D’Angelo Russell cut was a given. Carson Cooper will be in that spot by Monday. The primary remaining question is whether the Grizzlies roster Richie Saunders for camp or hold off on that (since he can’t play yet). If they wait, Hawkins and Peavy might both be in camp.
